events.event: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung announced and signed the 2027 Jakarta provincial minimum wage (UMP DKI), a middle path between labour and employer proposals under PP 49/2025.
events.key_numbers: UMP DKI 2027 Rp6,136,941 · up Rp407,065 (+7.1%) from Rp5,729,876 · unions demanded Rp6.24 million (per Liputan6 headline) · Dewan Pengupahan deliberated 3 days
events.why_it_matters: Sets the pay floor for millions of Jakarta workers in 2027 and is the template other provinces will follow.
events.spreading_evidence: Liputan6 terpopuler #1, #7 and #9 (UMP DKI items) on 20 Nov

events.event: West Jakarta police detailed how a PIK security guard climbing onto a car hood led to two narcotics officers being assaulted on the Sedyatmo toll road on 19 November.
events.key_numbers: 2 officers injured (Iptu Deni Tri Putra: forehead wound and thigh stab wound; Brigadir Dwi Santoso: head wound from a stone) · incident ~16:30 WIB 19 Nov · arrests not stated
events.why_it_matters: A viral video turned out to be police mistaken for hit-and-run suspects, raising questions on vigilante mobs and mistaken identity.
events.spreading_evidence: Liputan6 terpopuler #2 on 20 Nov; viral video noted 19 Nov

events.event: Bareskrim searched five houses in Bogor and Curug (Tangerang) in a treason (makar) case naming Brigjen Muhammad Tedjo Kusumo and Kombes Iman Imanudin, and postponed the case presentation with Kejagung to next week.
events.key_numbers: 5 houses searched since evening 19 Nov · ekspose with Kejagung moved from 20 Nov to the following week · wiretap case: 4 suspects, 3 detained at Rutan Mako Brimob
events.why_it_matters: The police-wiretap saga widens into a treason probe, touching the top of Polri.
events.spreading_evidence: Liputan6 terpopuler #4; CNN Indonesia Nasional multiple items 20 Nov

events.event: MPR started verifying documents of vice-presidential candidates to replace Gibran, while Mahfud MD argued the 9 December election could be invalid if held as planned.
events.key_numbers: MPR plenary vote set 9 Dec · Mahfud's legal argument not read in full (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Who becomes the next vice president, and whether the process is legal, is the biggest political question of the month.
events.spreading_evidence: Liputan6 terpopuler #6; detik terpopuler (16 Nov snapshot) Dasco/MPR items

events.event: Polri denied reports that the alleged rape case against Kupang Regent Yosef Lede ended in a settlement, and police have questioned more than a dozen witnesses.
events.key_numbers: Belasan (a dozen-plus) witnesses questioned · case already at investigation stage since 19 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Tests whether a sitting regional head faces the same law as ordinary citizens.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #16 (16 Nov); two CNN Indonesia items 20 Nov

events.event: Weather modification started in Aceh to shift rain out to sea after weeks of floods.
events.key_numbers: Details (agency, aircraft, duration) not verified, headline only · earlier BPBA count: 21,109 affected in five regencies/cities (17 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: A visible government response to repeated Aceh floods; shows how cloud seeding is used to cut disaster risk.

events.event: The Siantar Ekspres train caught fire after hitting a minibus (angkot), injuring three railway staff.
events.key_numbers: 3 railway staff injured · time of publication 17:52 20 Nov · other casualties unknown
events.why_it_matters: Level-crossing safety remains a recurring public transport risk.

events.event: Fact-checkers flagged new hoaxes targeting Megawati and other political figures, including fake business-capital aid and a claim she declared war on Muslims.
events.key_numbers: 3 Megawati hoaxes listed (Facebook 19 Oct 2026, Facebook Apr 2024, YouTube Jul 2021) · Liputan6 series also covers Kabinet Merah Putih, PSI, Yusril and a fake BRI prize draw
events.why_it_matters: Fake aid and prize offers using famous names are how many people lose money to scams.
